title: You’re not hearing a lie.
paragraphs:
You’re not hearing a lie.
You’re hearing… a version of the truth.

Because if it sounded evil—
you would’ve rejected it already.

“Maybe it’s not that serious…”
“God will forgive me anyway…”
“I’m still a good person…”

And now you’re stuck in something
you never planned to stay in.
Because this isn’t just about sin.

It’s about how deception feels safe
while it slowly poisons your soul.

You didn’t wake up one day
wanting to drift from God.

A thought you entertained.
A compromise you justified.
A desire you refused to surrender.
It didn’t feel wrong at first.

📖 “And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.”
— 2 Corinthians 11:14
Meaning deception doesn’t always look sinful.

You can be in sin
and still feel justified.

You can be far from God
and still feel at peace.

You can be deceived
and still feel in control.
That reflection smiling back at you?
The enemy doesn’t just whisper lies.

📖 “The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?”
— Jeremiah 17:9

📖 “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow me.”
— Luke 9:23

Because your heart can feel something
God never approved.

And if you follow it blindly—
you don’t find freedom.

You find bondage
with a smile on its face.
This is where it gets personal.

There are things you’ve been tolerating
that you once prayed against.

Things you used to call sin…
you now call “struggle.”

Things you used to fight…
you now manage.

But because something else
got louder.
This is not where your story ends.

Because right in the middle of deception,
God still speaks.

📖 “Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
— John 8:32

📖 “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.”
— John 14:6

And no amount of “trying harder”
can fix what only the cross can heal.
You chose your way over God’s.

📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.”
— Romans 3:23

📖 “For the wages of sin is death…”
— Romans 6:23
But God did not leave you there.

📖 “…but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.”
— Romans 6:23
Lived the life you couldn’t live.

And He paid for all of it
with His blood.

📖 “But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.”
— Romans 5:8
Not when you cleaned yourself up.
While you were still in it.
Not to a version of truth.

What have you been believing
that God never said?

What have you been tolerating
that the cross already paid for?

What voice have you trusted
more than His?

Because partial surrender
is still resistance.
And Jesus isn’t asking for improvement.
And if this stirred something deep in you…
From distortion to clarity — because Jesus rewrites everything.
